notes.title: Steam Survival Fest - ANKH TOWER is there!
notes.notes:
Dear Ankh Protectors,

We are happy to announce that our [b]Ankh Tower[/b] is featured among many great survival games!

[h3][b]The Steam Survival Fest is LIVE![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589109/25c43bfcdf97c0a652db42c1bbb6f5bd0ee37964.png[/img]
[b]

Ankh Tower is a dark-fantasy rogue-like strategy. In the depths of darkness, the Ankh remains the only bastion of life. Build your tower wisely using the offensive, defensive and magical capabilities of its floors. Develop your arsenal of spells to defeat evil forces. Protect the Ankh and survive.

notes.title: We’ve changed the name of the game!
notes.notes:
Dear Ankh Protectors,

We decided to change the name of our game. Now it's called:

[b]ANKH TOWER: PROTECT THE FORTRESS WITH DARK MAGIC[/b]

We believe that the new name will explain the core of the game a bit more. 

You need to use all powers and resources, even dark magic, to protect the [b]Ankh [/b]and your fortress.

[b]Do you like it?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589109/4d9a43eb308239d2b754001d03aab2d302a93f53.png[/img]

notes.title: Treasury Floor - part 1
notes.notes:
Dear Ankh Protectors,

You need to collect resources to upgrade your skills and improve the tower's protection.

[b]Gold [/b]is one of them.

Each day you will get some gold, after surviving the monsters' attack - but that might not be enough.

Use the [b]Treasury Floor[/b] to collect more. 

Open the chest and pick up the coin. You can use the chest more than once - but you have to wait for it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589109/5818aa5e224d93d914a2df8f32f00599cdabd062.png[/img]

notes.title: Boss Fight - Will you survive?
notes.notes:
Dear Ankh Protectors,

Monsters waves are challenging themselves (they come each night trying to defeat you). 

But the [b][u]real danger[/u][/b] comes from the powerful bosses that attack the [b]Ankh[/b] directly.

You have to fight with them and protect the [b]Ankh[/b]. 

Don't forget about the bottom floors - monsters are still trying to make your tower collapse!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589109/12723a285161067d4a4328ce689f9d4c1e197750.png[/img]

notes.title: Workshop Floor - Part 1
notes.notes:
Dear Ankh Protectors,

Discover each floor's possibilities to defeat the dark forces. 
Think a few steps ahead and build your tower wisely. Some of the floors can unleash the potential of the other ones. 

[b]Workshop Floor [/b] will help you prepare for the attack.
You can craft bows there (if you have enough resources). You need them to recruit the archers ([b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1353910/view/3212763528600158400]Military Floor[/url][/b]).  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589109/3168eac9f19e60ef70843aeab4a17f5411a0a5d5.png[/img]

notes.title: Military Floor - Part 1
notes.notes:
Dear Ankh Protectors,

Every floor in your tower provides different resources to fight the dark forces. You have to discover and combine them to unleash their real potential.

[b]Military Floor [/b] will help you repel the attack.
You can recruit archers there (if you have enough resources). They will use their bows and arrows to fight.

That will help you defend the tower when the next monster wave comes.
Especially, when monsters attack your tower from more than one direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589109/047ec72ae56e220378900dea62ec91fdf09bfb70.png[/img]

notes.title: Monsters Attack - Prepare To Fight!
notes.notes:
Dear Ankh Protectors,

In Ankh Tower, each night the monster wave is coming - trying to defeat you and destroy the Ankh.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589109/55cc2f2dda041ded5e8ceb079f7e4315d41bbe02.png[/img]

What's more, surviving one night means you won the battle, but not the whole war. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589109/6f6a0a721e53e6ddb20971e76afbbeeb97c01fbf.png[/img]

Choose wisely and find your strategy before the next monsters' wave arrival. You can expect them to be stronger than before.

Will they win?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589109/37f7851dda61ca9783ddbe84a2a449587f3cc70b.png[/img]

notes.title: Two Elements - Fire and Ice
notes.notes:
Two Elements - Fire and Ice are two antagonistic elements that impact the damage or resistance of both the tower floors and the monsters.

You have to develop your magical skills and craft your spells to be able to use all of them. Then you may decide which one - Fire or Ice - will help you survive each night and win the fight. 

Remember, you never know if your strategy will still be valid the next night, so always expect the unexpected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589109/bd228a5b363241c3f10270c5d2946a9ff0dc334b.png[/img]

notes.title: Key Mechanic - Collapse of the Tower
notes.notes:
Dear Ankh Protectors,

In the Ankh Tower you have to build your tower wisely using the offensive, defensive and magical capabilities of its floors. Each night the monsters attack the lowest floor which collapses when destroyed.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589109/a3844ad4f6b3934c52d3c8c4cf6bffc61081d949.gif[/img]

It means that the oldest floor built will be the first to be lost. These mechanics motivate you to think a few moves ahead and prioritize which floor should be built next.

notes.title: Upgrading the Ankh - does it look good?
notes.notes:
Dear Ankh Protectors,

In the Ankh Tower you have to protect the Ankh to survive. You can also upgrade it to unlock new features (like new floors or magic spells). It will also make your tower stronger.

Would you change something on the visual effect of upgrading the Ankh (see the screenshot below)?
